intro.line: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.
Every plane, all at once. The Mirran resistance fights on New Phyrexia while the rest of the Multiverse is invaded.

finale.line: Faced with a blast that would level not only New Phyrexia, but also a dozen innocent worlds, Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.
The invasion ends. The Omenpaths open across the Multiverse, and the planes can finally reach each other again.
Recorded: the Phyrexian arc ends here. What comes after belongs to the survivors.

villainFinale.line: In this version, Elesh Norn finishes the job, and there is no Multiverse left to argue about it.

battles.title: For Mirrodin!
battles.blurb: A strike team of raiders hits New Phyrexia. Vorinclex's poisonous beasts are waiting.

scene.line: It's hard to tell with this glare, but those must be the skyhunter reinforcements! They have arrived at last!
Our resistance is like the myr: small and easily overlooked, but loyal and resilient beyond measure.
Toxic: a creature with toxic gives poison counters as well as damage. Ten poison counters and the player loses.

villainScene.line: In Vorinclex's domain, only the mightiest survive, and all are prey in his endless hunt.
The strategies and politics of the Vicious Swarm are as subtle as Vorinclex himself.

battles.title: The Oil Spreads
battles.blurb: The Resistance defends a safehouse from the sectives of Jin-Gitaxias.

scene.line: Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside.
The oil is all-knowing. The trick is to ask the right questions.
Oil counters: Phyrexian permanents store them as they work. When they have enough, they pay off. Pressure them before that happens.

villainScene.line: It is Jin-Gitaxias's deepest exasperation that any part of his domain still requires maintenance.
Free will was an illusion so perfect it fooled even me. I know better now.

hero.half: Strike before their oil pays off.

battles.title: Defend Each Plane
battles.blurb: March of the Machine: a plane becomes a battle, and the defender has to hold it.

cards.name: Invasion of Belenon // Belenon War Anthem

scene.line: Ixalan greeted Phyrexia with a defiant roar.
Her warning raced through the roots and rivers of Ixalan: prepare for war.
Battles: an invasion is a battle. Attack it and defeat it to flip it, or defend it and keep the invaders out.

villainScene.line: Walls built to withstand assaults even from Ikoria's apex monsters were quickly deemed tactically irrelevant by Vorinclex's forces.
Popular wisdom says that Phyrexians don't feel fear.

hero.half: Defeat the battle before it flips.

battles.title: The Compleated
battles.blurb: Elesh Norn's cathedral is full of the compleated. The Mirran remnants have to take it back.

scene.line: The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule.
Silent observers swim through the air of Norn's Seedcore, watching the nascent Invasion Tree for any signs of interference.
Proliferate: add one more counter of each kind already on a permanent or player. Use it on your own growing things.

villainScene.line: Hear only harmony. See only glory. Speak only truth.
Drown, so you may breathe again.

hero.half: Add counters to what you already grow.

battles.title: Incubate
battles.blurb: Wrenn and the roots of the Realmbreaker. The Phyrexian factories keep making new things.

scene.line: This was once a peaceful spring, but I wouldn't advise taking a sip.
Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time.
Incubate: make an Incubator token with a number of counters, and pay later to turn it into a Phyrexian creature.

villainScene.line: This one needs a bit longer to ripen.

hero.half: Spend the incubator before they overwhelm you.

battles.title: Grixis vs Mono-White
battles.blurb: Spring 2023: a three-colour removal deck against mono-white weenies.

deck.name: Grixis Midrange
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Blue is dropped for our land pool; this is the black-red core.

scene.line: There's a war brewing between Norn and Urabrask. Exploit the chaos, and we can take them both down for good.
Congratulations. I am entertained.
Trade your removal for their best creatures. Draw extra cards with Phyrexian Arena and win the long game.

villainScene.line: There's never a need to change the watch, for the servants of Norn are sleepless.
There is a single, glorious truth, etched in the hearts of the faithful. Join in unity, or be washed away.

hero.half: Do not take too much damage early.

battles.title: Rakdos vs Esper Legends
battles.blurb: Spring 2023: Rakdos midrange against a deck full of legends.

scene.line: We both serve the Demon Thane. Your parts would better serve with me.
Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now.
Pressure their legends with removal and attackers before they stack up.

villainScene.line: May you rejoice in the magnificence of Norn. May your flesh serve perfection.

hero.half: Race them before the legends stack up.

battles.title: Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines
battles.blurb: Every plane stands against the Mother of Machines. Her creatures only have to be on the battlefield.

scene.line: Perhaps this will show the Orthodoxy what we think of their attempts at indoctrination.
Elspeth shone like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.
Her army comes cheap. Hold the line, then clear the board with Sunfall.

villainScene.line: Be not afraid of the holy chorus. Join in rapturous harmony.
Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.

hero.half: Clear the board before she overwhelms you.

battles.title: Four-Colour Atraxa
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a four-colour deck that wins on turn five or not at all.

archive.what: A four-colour deck of mana rocks and mana creatures that lands Atraxa, Grand Unifier by turn five.
archive.why: Atraxa drew a pile of cards from nothing and the deck had answers to everything else.
archive.beat: Kill the mana creatures early and keep a removal spell ready for Atraxa herself.
archive.after: Rotation took the deck apart, but Atraxa kept turning up in other decks.

deck.name: Four-Colour Atraxa
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: The five suns may have dimmed, but their light still guides us.
Go under them. Kill the mana creatures and hit before turn five.

after.line: Recorded: rotation took the deck apart, but Atraxa kept turning up in other decks.
